title: The two shipment-to-order lifecycle fixes are each pinned by exactly the test that fails without them
note: Both mutations are reverts of this cycle's fixes, replayed against the shipped tree. M1 restores the pre-fix update_fields list, which omits updated_at: save(update_fields=...) leaves auto_now columns out unless they are listed, so the order keeps its stale freshness marker while its status moves. M2 restores the pre-fix delivery gate, which advanced the whole order as soon as ONE parcel reached delivered: with a sibling still at label_created the order read delivered while the customer did not have the second parcel, which is the reported defect. Each replay's scope is the pin written for it, so a green run under the mutation is a survived mutant rather than a pass.

mutations.description: the order write drops updated_at from update_fields again, so a shipment-driven move leaves Order.updated_at at its stale value
the completeness gate is removed again, so one delivered parcel marks the whole split order delivered while its sibling is still in the warehouse
